FUN_CODE_dce3.brief: Report whether the 128-byte IR ring holds no data.
FUN_CODE_dce3.evidence: compares the write and read indexes of the ring read by sys_ir_ring_read_byte
FUN_CODE_dce3.plain: Checks whether any remote-control values are waiting.

FUN_CODE_dcf6.name: uart_setup_line_control
FUN_CODE_dcf6.brief: Set the serial line control registers and select the default port mode.
FUN_CODE_dcf6.evidence: reg 0xF053 = 0x83, 0xF055 = 6, then uart_set_line_format(1, 0) (per-port mode nibbles); part of the UART set-up
FUN_CODE_dcf6.plain: Prepares a serial link's data format.

FUN_CODE_dd09.name: Enable_DPMRX
FUN_CODE_dd09.brief: Log and enable both DisplayPort receivers for standby wake-up.
FUN_CODE_dd09.evidence: (original name printed: 'Enable_DPMRX'); calls DP_EnableMRX(0) and (1); mailbox command 0x2A
FUN_CODE_dd09.plain: Turns on the DisplayPort inputs so a computer can wake the monitor.

FUN_CODE_dd2f.name: USBCC_Initial
FUN_CODE_dd2f.brief: Select the CC port, initialise it and log the start-up.
FUN_CODE_dd2f.evidence: (original name printed: 'USBCC_Initial'); no caller in the image

FUN_CODE_dd63.name: sys_set_match_flag
FUN_CODE_dd63.brief: Store whether the last device check matched.
FUN_CODE_dd63.evidence: flag 0xA70C; only caller i2c_sw_match_device_id (I2C read compared with a 6-byte field)
FUN_CODE_dd63.plain: Remembers the result of a comparison.

FUN_CODE_dd74.name: reg_read_sync_meter_byte
FUN_CODE_dd74.brief: Read one register of the sync measurement block.
FUN_CODE_dd74.evidence: 8 callers in the standby signal checks (power_check_sync_timing, c0a1, cf38)
FUN_CODE_dd74.plain: Reads one measured value of the incoming signal timing.

FUN_CODE_dd85.name: reg_read_wake_block_byte
FUN_CODE_dd85.brief: Read one register of the wake detection block.
FUN_CODE_dd85.plain: Reads one setting of the wake-up detector.

FUN_CODE_dd96.name: flash_clear_transfer_buffer
FUN_CODE_dd96.brief: Fill the 2 KB flash transfer buffer with 0xFF.
FUN_CODE_dd96.evidence: buffer 0xA800..0xAFFF used by flash_read_to_buffer / flash_write_from_buffer; 0xFF = erased flash
FUN_CODE_dd96.plain: Empties the buffer used for flash reads and writes.

FUN_CODE_ddb6.name: uart_test_rx_reported
FUN_CODE_ddb6.brief: Report whether serial port n's received data is already reported.
FUN_CODE_ddb6.evidence: bit n of 0xA3E3, set by the report builder after a type 3 (serial data) report
FUN_CODE_ddb6.plain: Checks whether the main processor was already told about new serial data.

FUN_CODE_ddd6.name: lib_delay_nops
FUN_CODE_ddd6.brief: Wait n passes of four no-operation instructions.
FUN_CODE_ddd6.evidence: _nop_() loop; no caller in the image

FUN_CODE_dde5.name: flash_get_leon2_base_address
FUN_CODE_dde5.brief: Return the LEON flash window base saved during start-up.
FUN_CODE_dde5.evidence: value stored by the start-up copy startup_load_core_images, passed to FE2P_SetLeon2BaseAddress
FUN_CODE_dde5.plain: Gives the place in the flash where the main processor's program starts.

FUN_CODE_ddf4.name: ipc_step_poll_slot
FUN_CODE_ddf4.brief: Advance the mailbox poll slot counter through 0..3.
FUN_CODE_ddf4.evidence: counter 0xA3E2; only caller the mailbox service ipc_service_mailbox
FUN_CODE_ddf4.plain: Moves to the next of four message slots.

FUN_CODE_de03.name: sys_set_timed_toggle_target
FUN_CODE_de03.brief: Store a target word and select toggle mode for the timed effect.
FUN_CODE_de03.evidence: command 0x18; record 0xA735 stepped by sys_run_timed_ramp (mode 1 toggles bits at an address)
FUN_CODE_de03.plain: Sets up a value that the 8051 switches on and off over time.

FUN_CODE_de12.name: ipc_test_report_slot_free
FUN_CODE_de12.brief: Report whether the outgoing report record is empty and can be refilled.
FUN_CODE_de12.evidence: byte count 0xA3EA of the report record; the builder ipc_fill_report_record runs only when it is 0
FUN_CODE_de12.plain: Checks whether the 8051 may prepare its next message for the main processor.

FUN_CODE_de2e.name: Disable_DPMRX
FUN_CODE_de2e.brief: Log and switch off the DisplayPort receivers' standby request handling.
FUN_CODE_de2e.evidence: (original name printed: 'Disable_DPMRX'); mailbox command 0x2B, then dp_mrx_disable_aux_irqs
FUN_CODE_de2e.plain: Stops the DisplayPort inputs from waking the monitor.

FUN_CODE_de50.name: uart_test_no_rx_data
FUN_CODE_de50.brief: Report whether no serial port has received data to pass on.
FUN_CODE_de50.evidence: uart_find_port_with_rx_data returns the port 1..4 with data or 0xFF; tested by the report builder before a type 3 report
FUN_CODE_de50.plain: Checks whether any serial link has new data for the main processor.

FUN_CODE_de87.name: usb_cc_set_mode2_ch0
FUN_CODE_de87.brief: Select mode 2 for CC channel 0 and apply it.
FUN_CODE_de87.evidence: mode 0xA780 = 2 then usb_cc_set_mode_ch0, as at the end of 'Initial CC PHY'; no caller
FUN_CODE_de87.plain: Puts the first USB-C channel into one fixed mode.

FUN_CODE_de92.name: ddc_test_none_pending
FUN_CODE_de92.brief: Report whether no DDC/CI channel has a message waiting.
FUN_CODE_de92.evidence: pending byte 0xA0F3 is 0; tested by the report builder before a type 4 report
FUN_CODE_de92.plain: Checks whether any monitor-control message waits for the main processor.

FUN_CODE_dea6.name: sys_ir_ring_test_empty
FUN_CODE_dea6.brief: Report whether the IR ring is empty (bit result)
FUN_CODE_dea6.evidence: bit form of sys_ir_ring_is_empty; the report builder sends the ring ('Reload IR') when it is not
FUN_CODE_dea6.plain: Checks whether any remote-control values are waiting.

FUN_CODE_deb0.name: power_take_cec_wake_request
FUN_CODE_deb0.brief: Return and clear the flag of a CEC power-up request.
FUN_CODE_deb0.evidence: bit 0x11 set by the CEC request printer hdmi_cec_report_request for _SYS_CECRequest_PowerUp and Power control
FUN_CODE_deb0.plain: Tells the main loop once that a TV or player asked the monitor to switch on.

FUN_CODE_dedc.name: hdmi_cec_get_operand
FUN_CODE_dedc.brief: Return the operand byte of the last CEC request.
FUN_CODE_dedc.evidence: byte 0xA759; hdmi_cec_report_request treats DeviceControl_Power with operand 0x40 as power-up
FUN_CODE_dedc.plain: Gives the detail value of the last command from a TV or player.

FUN_CODE_dee2.name: ddc_get_pending_channels
FUN_CODE_dee2.brief: Return the bit mask of DDC/CI channels with a message waiting.
FUN_CODE_dee2.evidence: byte 0xA0F3; one bit per channel row at 0xA0F4
FUN_CODE_dee2.plain: Lists the monitor-control messages that wait for the main processor.

FUN_CODE_def4.name: uart_init
FUN_CODE_def4.brief: Set up the serial ports, the timers and their interrupts.
FUN_CODE_def4.evidence: uart_setup_line_control then uart_init_8051_serial; called in the application start-up
FUN_CODE_def4.plain: Prepares the 8051's serial links and clocks at start-up.

FUN_CODE_defa.name: uart_get_rx_write_index_p4_low
FUN_CODE_defa.brief: Return the low byte of the serial port 4 receive ring write position (IDATA 0x4B).
FUN_CODE_defa.evidence: IDATA 0x4B = low byte of uart_rx_write_index_port4 (0x4A); no caller in the image
FUN_CODE_defa.plain: An unused helper that reads part of a serial receive counter.

thunk_FUN_CODE_568f.name: ddc_rearm_idle_slaves_thunk
thunk_FUN_CODE_568f.evidence: single LJMP to ddc_rearm_idle_slaves (ddc_rearm_idle_slaves); called from sys_service_ddc_and_cec
thunk_FUN_CODE_568f.plain: Passes control on to the routine that readies the monitor-control links again.

FUN_CODE_df0b.name: sys_is_on_crystal_clock
FUN_CODE_df0b.brief: Report whether the 8051 runs on its slow crystal clock.
FUN_CODE_df0b.evidence: bit 0x0E set on power saving / power off, cleared at start-up; sys_get_cpu_clock_hz returns 12 MHz when set
FUN_CODE_df0b.plain: Tells whether the 8051 is in its slow, low-power clock mode.

FUN_CODE_bbca.name: edid_set_port_entries
FUN_CODE_bbca.brief: Enable and set the EDID slave entry of each port selected by mask.
FUN_CODE_bbca.evidence: mailbox command 0x0E; port pairs 0xF180 + 2i / 0xF181 + 2i bit 7, the pairs edid_clear_port_entries clears
FUN_CODE_bbca.plain: Sets up the display-data answer of several video inputs in one go.

FUN_CODE_cfe7.name: uart_flush_tx_queue_port3
FUN_CODE_cfe7.brief: Send the queued bytes of serial port 3 and empty the queue.
FUN_CODE_cfe7.notes: Waits while the transmit buffer is full (status bit 3).
FUN_CODE_cfe7.evidence: twin of uart_flush_tx_queue_port2; message type 3 sub 3, data reg 0xF037, baud regs 0xF033/34
FUN_CODE_cfe7.plain: Sends the waiting text of the third serial link.

FUN_CODE_d24a.name: sys_switch_to_pll_clock
FUN_CODE_d24a.brief: Switch the 8051 to the PLL clock once locked and set the fast timer rates.
FUN_CODE_d24a.evidence: lock bit 7 of reg 0xD90B; divider to 0xD929, new timer 0 reload and timer 1 baud value
FUN_CODE_d24a.plain: Puts the 8051 on its fast clock when that clock is ready.

FUN_CODE_d66e.name: usb_cc_select_port_block
FUN_CODE_d66e.brief: Point the CC register block pointer at the selected Type-C port.
FUN_CODE_d66e.evidence: bits 0..1 of 0xA6A5 select block 0xB250 or 0x1A50 (same selection picks the CC readings)
FUN_CODE_d66e.plain: Chooses which USB-C connector the 8051 talks to.

FUN_CODE_d75e.name: dp_mrx_disable_aux_irqs
FUN_CODE_d75e.brief: Turn off the AUX request interrupts of both DisplayPort receivers.
FUN_CODE_d75e.evidence: clears bit 0 of the request control regs 0xDCDE/DF and 0xDCCE/CF tested by the AUX interrupt dp_aux_service
FUN_CODE_d75e.plain: Stops the 8051 from answering DisplayPort requests itself.

FUN_CODE_d862.name: sys_ir_ring_is_full
FUN_CODE_d862.brief: Report whether the 128-byte IR ring has no free slot.
FUN_CODE_d862.evidence: write index one behind the read index (wrap at 0x7F); used by the ring writer irq_record_ir_pulse
FUN_CODE_d862.plain: Checks whether the remote-control queue is full.

FUN_CODE_d969.name: lib_is_within_distance
FUN_CODE_d969.brief: Report whether two values differ by less than a limit.
FUN_CODE_d969.evidence: |a - b| < limit; used by the IR code matcher
FUN_CODE_d969.plain: Checks whether two measurements are close enough to count as equal.

FUN_CODE_d987.name: uart_init_8051_serial
FUN_CODE_d987.brief: Set up the 8051 serial port, both timers and their interrupts.
FUN_CODE_d987.evidence: standard 8051 SFRs: SCON = 0x52, TMOD = 0x21, PCON.SMOD, TR0/TR1, EX0/EX1/ET0/ES, PS
FUN_CODE_d987.plain: Starts the 8051's own serial link and timers.

FUN_CODE_dbf6.name: timer_get_counts_per_ms
FUN_CODE_dbf6.brief: Return the timer 0 counts that make one millisecond on this chip.
FUN_CODE_dbf6.evidence: 4000 on chip id 0x20 (48 MHz / 12), else 8000 (96 MHz / 12); used to compute the tick reload
FUN_CODE_dbf6.plain: Tells the timer how far to count for one millisecond.

FUN_CODE_dc3b.name: sys_service_ddc_and_cec
FUN_CODE_dc3b.brief: Re-arm idle DDC/CI links and, while off or saving power, report CEC requests.
FUN_CODE_dc3b.evidence: ddc_rearm_idle_slaves, then hdmi_cec_report_request (prints _SYS_CECRequest_*) when run state 0xA770 is 0 or 1
FUN_CODE_dc3b.plain: Keeps the monitor-control links ready and listens for TV or player commands in standby.

FUN_CODE_dc51.name: flash_begin_access
FUN_CODE_dc51.brief: Claim the SPI flash interface for the 8051 before a flash job.
FUN_CODE_dc51.evidence: sets bit 7 of reg 0xF1DF (bit 0 of 0xF1A8 cleared on chip 0x1A); called at the start of every flash routine
FUN_CODE_dc51.plain: Takes over the flash chip before reading or writing it.

FUN_CODE_dc67.name: flash_end_access
FUN_CODE_dc67.brief: Release the SPI flash interface after a flash job.
FUN_CODE_dc67.evidence: undoes flash_begin_access; called at the end of every flash routine
FUN_CODE_dc67.plain: Gives the flash chip back after reading or writing it.

FUN_CODE_dd41.name: sys_restart_key_scan_timer
FUN_CODE_dd41.brief: Clear the scan flag and restart the key scan timer.
FUN_CODE_dd41.evidence: flag 0xA629 and tick stamp 0xA5EB used by the key scan power_scan_wake_keys; power saving / power off commands
FUN_CODE_dd41.plain: Restarts the timing of the button checks.

FUN_CODE_de20.name: sys_lookup_clock_factor
FUN_CODE_de20.brief: Return the timing factor for a clock divider setting from a table.
FUN_CODE_de20.evidence: CODE table 0xDC89 indexed by the divider bits of reg 0xD929
FUN_CODE_de20.plain: Looks up a timing value for the current clock speed.

FUN_CODE_de3a.name: hdmi_cec_set_two_regs
FUN_CODE_de3a.brief: Write the two values of mailbox command 0x24 into CEC block registers.
FUN_CODE_de3a.plain: Applies two CEC settings sent by the main processor.

FUN_CODE_de45.name: flash_set_job_length
FUN_CODE_de45.brief: Set the flash job length in 256-byte units when non-zero.
FUN_CODE_de45.evidence: length word 0xA715 used by flash_read_to_buffer / flash_write_from_buffer; mailbox command 0x14
FUN_CODE_de45.plain: Sets how much data the next flash read or write moves.

FUN_CODE_de5b.name: i2c_test_no_result_ready
FUN_CODE_de5b.brief: Report whether no I2C read result waits to be reported.
FUN_CODE_de5b.evidence: flag 0xA35F set by the message type 2 I2C job; the report builder sends type 2 when it is 1
FUN_CODE_de5b.plain: Checks whether an I2C answer waits for the main processor.

FUN_CODE_de66.name: power_arm_signal_detect
FUN_CODE_de66.brief: Set the two signal detector levels used for the standby signal check.
FUN_CODE_de66.evidence: regs 0xD507/0xD508 = 0x37 before the check in power_check_sync_input_alt
FUN_CODE_de66.plain: Prepares the detector that notices an incoming picture signal.

FUN_CODE_de71.name: power_disarm_signal_detect
FUN_CODE_de71.brief: Write 0x88 to the two registers 0xD507 / 0xD508 after a failed signal check.
FUN_CODE_de71.evidence: regs 0xD507/0xD508 = 0x88 on the failure path of power_check_sync_input_alt; power_arm_signal_detect writes 0x37 to both before the check
FUN_CODE_de71.plain: Puts the signal detector back after no picture was found.

FUN_CODE_de7c.name: sys_restore_crystal_timing
FUN_CODE_de7c.brief: Set the two clock-scaled timing registers to their crystal values.
FUN_CODE_de7c.evidence: regs 0xDCB1 = 9, 0xDCB2 = 15 (sys_scale_timing_to_clock with factor 1); after the crystal clock switch
FUN_CODE_de7c.plain: Resets two timing values when the 8051 returns to its slow clock.

FUN_CODE_de9c.name: edid_test_readback_requested
FUN_CODE_de9c.brief: Report whether a read-back of the EDID buffer was requested.
FUN_CODE_de9c.evidence: length 0xA46C set by mailbox command 0x0D; report type 1 sends the 0xF800 EDID buffer
FUN_CODE_de9c.plain: Checks whether the main processor asked to read back the display data block.

FUN_CODE_deb9.name: sys_ir_ring_flush
FUN_CODE_deb9.brief: Discard everything in the IR ring.
FUN_CODE_deb9.evidence: sets the write index to the read index; only call in sys_main at the end of a wake-up, right after the run state becomes 'running'

FUN_CODE_dec2.name: sys_set_timed_limits_ch0
FUN_CODE_dec2.brief: Store the first value pair (top, bottom) of the timed toggle / ramp record.

params.name: top
params.meaning: toggle: first register value; ramp: top end

params.name: bottom

FUN_CODE_dec2.evidence: mailbox command 0x19; limits[0] of the record 0xA735 used by sys_run_timed_ramp
FUN_CODE_dec2.plain: Sets the range of the first gradual change.

FUN_CODE_decb.name: sys_set_timed_limits_ch1
FUN_CODE_decb.brief: Store the second value pair (top, bottom) of the timed toggle / ramp record.

params.name: top
params.meaning: toggle: second register value; ramp: top end

params.name: bottom
params.meaning: toggle: hold time of that value in units of 100 ticks; ramp: bottom end

FUN_CODE_decb.evidence: mailbox command 0x1A; limits[1] of the record 0xA735 used by sys_run_timed_ramp
FUN_CODE_decb.plain: Sets the range of the second gradual change.

FUN_CODE_dee8.name: flash_set_fe2p_extend
FUN_CODE_dee8.brief: Store the FE2P extended address sent by the main processor.
FUN_CODE_dee8.plain: Remembers the upper address part used for the main processor's flash window.

FUN_CODE_deee.name: sys_set_adc_key_tolerance
FUN_CODE_deee.brief: Store the tolerance used when matching ADC key readings.
FUN_CODE_deee.evidence: byte 0xA62E = g in the key scan power_scan_wake_keys ('ADC key %BX %BX %BX'); mailbox command 0x1B
FUN_CODE_deee.plain: Sets how exact a button's voltage must be to count as that button.
